lines.text: Hi, I'm Sunny! Poke a button with one finger.
lines.spoken: Hi, I'm Sunny! Poke a button with one finger.

lines.text: Here's a quick tour.
lines.spoken: Here's a quick tour.

lines.text: Don't want my tips? Turn off Tips while I play.
lines.spoken: Don't want my tips? Turn off Tips while I play.

lines.text: Turn it back on to bring me back.
lines.spoken: Turn it back on to bring me back.

lines.text: Poke My set to bring them all back.
lines.spoken: Poke My set to bring them all back.

lines.text: Press REC to record.
lines.spoken: Press rec to record.

lines.text: Press STOP to finish.
lines.spoken: Press stop to finish.

lines.text: Lessons are here. Pick a song and play along.
lines.spoken: Lessons are here. Pick a song and play along.

lines.text: That's the tour! Find me in the menu anytime.
lines.spoken: That's the tour! Find me in the menu anytime.

lines.text: Flip SNOW for snow all around you. FIRE and WIND too!
lines.spoken: Flip snow for snow all around you. Fire and wind too!

lines.text: Turn on Move instruments, then pinch one and drag it.
lines.spoken: Turn on Move instruments, then pinch one and drag it.

lines.text: Poke tiles to choose My set, or try One alone.
lines.spoken: Poke tiles to choose My set, or try One alone.

lines.text: Press REC to record, then PLAY to hear it.
lines.spoken: Press rec to record, then play to hear it.

lines.text: Your recordings are saved here.
lines.spoken: Your recordings are saved here.

lines.text: Recenter with Reset view or pinch and hold both hands.
lines.spoken: Recenter with Reset view or pinch and hold both hands.

lines.text: Press GUIDE for a one-minute song. Have fun!
lines.spoken: Press guide for a one-minute song. Have fun!

lines.text: Tip: poke me anytime to skip.
lines.spoken: Tip: poke me anytime to skip.

lines.text: Now tap the drum on your right.
lines.spoken: Now tap the drum on your right.

lines.text: Tap the top of the drum, like this.
lines.spoken: Tap the top of the drum, like this.

lines.text: Nod your head, like me.
lines.spoken: Nod your head, like me.

lines.text: Now sweep your fingers across the harp strings.
lines.spoken: Now sweep your fingers across the harp strings.

lines.text: Slide your fingers through the strings, like this.
lines.spoken: Slide your fingers through the strings, like this.

lines.text: Palm toward your face, like this.
lines.spoken: Palm toward your face, like this.

lines.text: Show your palm again, like this.
lines.spoken: Show your palm again, like this.

lines.text: Want more? Point at an instrument and pinch.
lines.spoken: Want more? Point at an instrument and pinch.

lines.text: You can also bring them from Instruments in the menu.
lines.spoken: You can also bring them from Instruments in the menu.

lines.text: That's middle C. Every key shows its letter.
lines.spoken: That's middle C. Every key shows its letter.

lines.text: Pinch a stick on the snare to pick it up.
lines.spoken: Pinch a stick on the snare to pick it up.

lines.text: Open your hand to put the stick back.
lines.spoken: Open your hand to put the stick back.

lines.text: Pinch the hi-hat stand to open it.
lines.spoken: Pinch the hi hat stand to open it.

lines.text: Hold a ringing cymbal to stop it.
lines.spoken: Hold a ringing cymbal to stop it.

lines.text: Red strings are C. Blue strings are F.
lines.spoken: Red strings are C. Blue strings are F.

lines.text: Rest your hand on the strings to quiet them.
lines.spoken: Rest your hand on the strings to quiet them.

lines.text: Flip these switches for fire, wind and snow.
lines.spoken: Flip these switches for fire, wind and snow.

lines.text: It's snowing inside! Flip SNOW off any time.
lines.spoken: It's snowing inside! Flip snow off any time.

lines.text: Press FIRE and a fireplace lights up in your room.
lines.spoken: Press fire and a fireplace lights up in your room.

lines.text: This tape deck records what you play.
lines.spoken: This tape deck records what you play.

lines.text: Recording! Play something, then press STOP.
lines.spoken: Recording! Play something, then press stop.

lines.text: Press LOOP again to add a layer on top.
lines.spoken: Press loop again to add a layer on top.

lines.text: Press CLEAR again to erase the loop.
lines.spoken: Press clear again to erase the loop.

lines.text: Pick a tempo and a length before you press LOOP.
lines.spoken: Pick a tempo and a length before you press loop.

lines.text: Press CLICK to keep a steady beat.
lines.spoken: Press click to keep a steady beat.

lines.text: TIDY gently evens out your timing.
lines.spoken: Tidy gently evens out your timing.

lines.text: Your loop is saved in Recordings.
lines.spoken: Your loop is saved in Recordings.

lines.text: Press GUIDE and we'll make a magic song together.
lines.spoken: Press guide and we'll make a magic song together.

lines.text: Let's make magic! Flip the SNOW switch.
lines.spoken: Let's make magic! Flip the snow switch.

lines.text: Saved! Now press PLAY and watch the magic.
lines.spoken: Saved! Now press play and watch the magic.

lines.text: Wow! Look, your song fills the whole room.
lines.spoken: Wow! Look, your song fills the whole room.

lines.text: Sit back and watch the butterflies dance to your song.
lines.spoken: Sit back and watch the butterflies dance to your song.

lines.text: Keep playing! The room comes alive while you record.
lines.spoken: Keep playing! The room comes alive while you record.

lines.text: Your recording brings its instruments to you.
lines.spoken: Your recording brings its instruments to you.

lines.text: Even the snow and the sky dance to your song.
lines.spoken: Even the snow and the sky dance to your song.

lines.text: Look up! Your song is drawing its own stars.
lines.spoken: Look up! Your song is drawing its own stars.

lines.text: Look! Your song paints flowers, trees and birds.
lines.spoken: Look! Your song paints flowers, trees and birds.

lines.text: Like it? Turn on Keep painting in Recordings.
lines.spoken: Like it? Turn on Keep painting in Recordings.

lines.text: Flick your hand at a wall to throw some paint!
lines.spoken: Flick your hand at a wall to throw some paint!

lines.text: Your song is now a painting on the wall.
lines.spoken: Your song is now a painting on the wall.

lines.text: Those are your hands from before, playing your song.
lines.spoken: Those are your hands from before, playing your song.

lines.text: Press REC while it plays to add a part on top.
lines.spoken: Press rec while it plays to add a part on top.

lines.text: Swipe fast, with your palm facing sideways.
lines.spoken: Swipe fast, with your palm facing sideways.

lines.text: Pinch the air and pull sideways to turn your seat.
lines.spoken: Pinch the air and pull sideways to turn your seat.

lines.text: Pinch both hands and hold still to bring them back.
lines.spoken: Pinch both hands and hold still to bring them back.

lines.text: Or poke Reset view in the menu.
lines.spoken: Or poke Reset view in the menu.

lines.text: Far away? Point at it and pinch.
lines.spoken: Far away? Point at it and pinch.

lines.text: Turn your wrist to spin it all the way round.
lines.spoken: Turn your wrist to spin it all the way round.

lines.text: Or hold it with both hands and twist.
lines.spoken: Or hold it with both hands and twist.

lines.text: Lift or lower it to your height.
lines.spoken: Lift or lower it to your height.

lines.text: Poke Done to play again. Reset starts over.
lines.spoken: Poke Done to play again. Reset starts over.

lines.text: I'll remember this setup next time.
lines.spoken: I'll remember this setup next time.

lines.text: Pinch and hold the menu's edge to move it.
lines.spoken: Pinch and hold the menu's edge to move it.

lines.text: To move one, turn on Move instruments in the menu.
lines.spoken: To move one, turn on Move instruments in the menu.

lines.text: Instruments are quiet while moving. Poke Done to play.
lines.spoken: Instruments are quiet while moving. Poke Done to play.

lines.text: Drag the list up or down to see more.
lines.spoken: Drag the list up or down to see more.

lines.text: Poke the title to go back.
lines.spoken: Poke the title to go back.

lines.text: Pick an instrument, then a song.
lines.spoken: Pick an instrument, then a song.

lines.text: Play each block as it lands. It waits for you.
lines.spoken: Play each block as it lands. It waits for you.

lines.text: For the kick, nod your head or tap the pad.
lines.spoken: For the kick, nod your head or tap the pad.

lines.text: Pluck the string where the block lands.
lines.spoken: Pluck the string where the block lands.

lines.text: Well done! Poke Next, or play it again.
lines.spoken: Well done! Poke Next, or play it again.

lines.text: Poke One alone to play just one instrument.
lines.spoken: Poke One alone to play just one instrument.

lines.text: Poke Options on a tile to change how it sounds.
lines.spoken: Poke Options on a tile to change how it sounds.

lines.text: Poke a recording to play it. The bin deletes it.
lines.spoken: Poke a recording to play it. The bin deletes it.

lines.text: Poke Delete again within three seconds to remove it.
lines.spoken: Poke Delete again within three seconds to remove it.

lines.text: Tap it again to close the app.
lines.spoken: Tap it again to close the app.

lines.text: You can hide me from the menu.
lines.spoken: You can hide me from the menu.

lines.text: This is your room! The piano is on your table.
lines.spoken: This is your room! The piano is on your table.

lines.text: Allow spatial data in settings so I can see your room.
lines.spoken: Allow spatial data in settings so I can see your room.

lines.text: Set up my room, in the menu, finds your walls.
lines.spoken: Set up my room, in the menu, finds your walls.

lines.text: Your instruments always open right in front of you.
lines.spoken: Your instruments always open right in front of you.

lines.text: In Instruments, poke Real hands to see your own hands.
lines.spoken: In Instruments, poke Real hands to see your own hands.

lines.text: Music room, in the menu, takes you back.
lines.spoken: Music room, in the menu, takes you back.

lines.text: Rub the rim slowly and steadily to make the bowl sing.
lines.spoken: Rub the rim slowly and steadily to make the bowl sing.

lines.text: Look at something and pinch to choose it.
lines.spoken: Look at something and pinch to choose it.
